correctness.rationale: For an idempotent in the leaf extension, every new-coordinate equation forces the corresponding leaf coefficient to zero, reducing to an idempotent of the seed. Non-degeneracy follows because every natural-basis square is nonzero. The graph remains connected by attaching leaves to e1, and the standard non-degenerate graph criterion gives indecomposability. The seed derived terms embed termwise into those of the extension, so nonsolvability is preserved. The Hu--Wen seed satisfies the hypotheses in characteristic different from 2.

originality.rationale: The final claim is a structural leaf-extension preservation lemma, not merely existence of higher-dimensional counterexamples. Hu--Wen explicitly use zero direct sums above dimension three. Barei remarks that his three-dimensional example can be extended to any dimension, but the complete paper does not state non-degeneracy, connectedness, indecomposability, annihilator control, or a general leaf-extension preservation theorem. The decomposition literature supplies only the graph criterion.
